arguments.content: P1 recovery state pattern: a provider-applied marker does not freeze the submitted payload when a failed operation permits edits before retry. If receipt persistence fails after an idempotent replacement, retrying with edited values must apply and record the latest values before completing; a pending-only apply guard silently acknowledges stale data. Reproduced staged service.py via client.submit: blue applied, receipt fails leaving applied state, green retry returns ok with blue still active; HEAD feeb199add2b6ae7b800a45b7b6856ab45ad2a67 activates green. Keep the completed-operation receipt fast path separate so correcting editable retries does not reapply values for completed IDs.
